name: TANYA KAPOOR
pullQuote: “Before MACzine, consumer research in DU was generic. We proved undergrads could conduct primary ethnographies, dissect FMCG supply chains, and publish reports referenced by actual CMOs.”
fullLetter: Leading the Research and Editorial wing was an uncompromising masterclass in intellectual rigor. We didn't want fluffy student articles; we demanded cold data, primary field interviews, and hard-hitting investigative brand autopsies.
Publishing the annual edition was an adrenaline rush—from proofreading 60-page layouts at midnight to distributing hardbound copies across college libraries and industry partners.
Remember: marketing without research is just noise. Dig into the numbers, question every trend, and write with absolute clarity.
